description.en:
Basic Attack

Danjin performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Danjin consumes STA to launch consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to launch an attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades

After a successful Dodge Counter, Danjin can use Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment to perform Resonance Skill: Crimson Erosion.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Danjin melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Danjin mengonsumsi STA untuk melancarkan serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-air Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk melancarkan serangan, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades

Setelah Dodge Counter berhasil, Danjin dapat menggunakan Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment untuk melakukan Resonance Skill: Crimson Erosion.

description.en:
When casting Crimson Fragment, each attack consumes 3% of Danjin's max HP. When Danjin's HP is less than 1%, this no longer consumes HP.

Carmine Gleam

Danjin attacks the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Crimson Erosion

After Basic Attack 2, Dodge Counter or Intro Skill Vindication, use Resonance Skill to perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG.
When Crimson Erosion 2 hits a target, apply Incinerating Will to it.

Incinerating Will

Danjin's damage dealt to targets marked with Incinerating Will is increased by 20%.

Sanguine Pulse

Use Resonance Skill after Basic Attack 3 to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id:
Saat menggunakan Crimson Fragment, setiap serangan mengonsumsi 3% HP maks Danjin. Saat HP Danjin kurang dari 1%, HP tidak lagi dikonsumsi.

Carmine Gleam

Danjin menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Crimson Erosion

Setelah Basic Attack 2, Dodge Counter, atau Intro Skill Vindication, gunakan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan hingga 2 tebasan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Saat Crimson Erosion 2 mengenai target, berikan Incinerating Will padanya.

Incinerating Will

Damage yang diberikan Danjin ke target yang ditandai Incinerating Will meningkat sebesar 20%.

Sanguine Pulse

Gunakan Resonance Skill setelah Basic Attack 3 untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en: Danjin's anger intensifies as she frantically swings her dual blades, performing multiple rapid consecutive attacks, and 1 Scarlet Burst attack(s), dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id: Amarah Danjin memuncak saat ia mengayunkan sepasang bilahnya dengan membabi buta, melakukan beberapa serangan beruntun yang cepat, dan 1 serangan Scarlet Burst, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en: Damage of Resonance Skill Crimson Erosion triggered by Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades is increased by 20%. The HP cost and stacks of Ruby Blossom recovered are doubled.
description.id: Damage Resonance Skill Crimson Erosion yang dipicu oleh Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades meningkat sebesar 20%. Biaya HP dan stack Ruby Blossom yang dipulihkan menjadi dua kali lipat.

description.en: After casting the Resonance Skill Sanguine Pulse, Danjin's Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 30% for 5s.
description.id: Setelah menggunakan Resonance Skill Sanguine Pulse, Heavy Attack DMG Danjin meningkat sebesar 30% selama 5 dtk.

description.en: With unwavering determination, Danjin unleashes a strike, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id: Dengan tekad yang tak tergoyahkan, Danjin melancarkan satu serangan, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave

After accumulating 60 "Ruby Blossom", long press Basic Attack to consume all "Ruby Blossom" to cast Chaoscleave, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and healing Danjin.
If current "Ruby Blossom" reaches over 120, 120 "Ruby Blossom" is consumed instead to increase the DMG multiplier of Chaoscleave and Scatterbloom performed this time.

Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom

Use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack Chaoscleave to cast Scatterbloom to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Ruby Blossom

Danjin can hold up to 120 Ruby Blossom.
Danjin obtains "Ruby Blossom" when using Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave

Setelah mengumpulkan 60 "Ruby Blossom", tahan lama Basic Attack untuk mengonsumsi seluruh "Ruby Blossom" guna melancarkan Chaoscleave, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG, dan memulihkan HP Danjin.
Jika "Ruby Blossom" saat ini melebihi 120, yang dikonsumsi hanya 120 "Ruby Blossom" untuk meningkatkan DMG multiplier Chaoscleave dan Scatterbloom yang dilakukan kali ini.

Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack Chaoscleave untuk melancarkan Scatterbloom guna menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Ruby Blossom

Danjin dapat menyimpan hingga 120 Ruby Blossom.
Danjin mendapat "Ruby Blossom" saat menggunakan Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Havoc DMG Amplified by 23% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Havoc DMG sebesar 23% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her ATK is increased by 5% for 6s, stacking up to 6 times. Danjin loses 1 stacks of this effect each time she takes damage.
description.id: Saat Danjin menyerang target yang terkena Incinerating Will dari Resonance Skill, ATK-nya meningkat sebesar 5% selama 6 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 6 kali. Danjin kehilangan 1 stack efek ini setiap kali menerima damage.

description.en: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her damage dealt is increased by 20%.
description.id: Saat Danjin menyerang target yang terkena Incinerating Will dari Resonance Skill, damage yang diberikannya meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 30%.
description.id: Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 30%.

description.en:
When Danjin has more than 60 "Ruby Blossom", her Crit. Rate is increased by 15%.
This effect lasts until the end of Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom even after all "Ruby Blossom" is consumed when casting Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave.
description.id:
Saat Danjin memiliki lebih dari 60 "Ruby Blossom", Crit. Rate-nya meningkat sebesar 15%.
Efek ini bertahan hingga Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom selesai, meskipun seluruh "Ruby Blossom" telah dikonsumsi saat melancarkan Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave.

description.en: Danjin's Havoc DMG Bonus is increased by 15%, and further increased by another 15% when her HP is lower than 60%.
description.id: Havoc DMG Bonus Danjin meningkat sebesar 15%, dan meningkat lagi sebesar 15% saat HP-nya di bawah 60%.

description.en: Heavy Attack Chaoscleave increases the ATK of all team members by 20% for 20s.
description.id: Heavy Attack Chaoscleave meningkatkan ATK seluruh anggota tim sebesar 20% selama 20 dtk.
